title: Dane Groeneveld (CEO / Host, The Future of Teamwork podcast) — Eric on the Responsive stage: 'good companies slide into bad companies'
summary: Dane Groeneveld — CEO/Founder and host of The Future of Teamwork podcast and YouTube channel — publishes a Responsive Conference recap tying together Dart Lindsley's 'Means → Ends' board exercise, Eric's Incorruptible talk on how good companies slide into bad companies, and Andre Martin on Zones of Genius. Frames the trio as one arc from treating humans as means-of-production to building companies that unlock meaning.
blockquote: Dart Lindsley led us through a great exercise at Work in Progress this week in the lead up to Responsive Conference. Means ——————————— Ends …this is what he wrote on the board. In the simplest and shortest way of honoring the conversation we explored that language and mindset many use in the workplace treats humans as a means to an end (a means of production, headcount, assets, employees). Then Eric Ries came on stage to talk about incorruptible… and how good companies slide into bad companies.
